technique_name: Write a Wikipedia page summarizing the details of the given event.
description: The Great Chicago Fire was a conflagration that burned in the American city of Chicago, Illinois, from October 8 to October 10, 1871. The fire killed up to 300 people, destroyed roughly 3.3 square miles of the city, and left more than 100,000 people homeless. The cause of the fire is unknown, but it started in a small barn owned by a Mrs. O'Leary and spread quickly with the help of strong winds.
